description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeQualificationsController class, which manages the presentation and permissions of employee qualification data within the OrangeHRM platform. It prepares data for frontend components related to employee languages and qualifications, and sets appropriate permissions based on employee context.

classes.name: EmployeeQualificationsController
classes.description: Controller class handling display and permissions for employee qualifications, utilizing Vue components and managing language and competency data.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component for rendering, including setting employee data, language and competency options, and permissions based on the request context.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Returns a list of qualification-related data groups for capability permission checks.
